mapper.select: SELECT near_reward_enabled, winback_enabled, winback_days, unused_gift_enabled FROM reminder_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE reminder_settings SET near_reward_enabled = #{nearRewardEnabled}, winback_enabled = #{winbackEnabled}, winback_days = #{winbackDays}, unused_gift_enabled = #{unusedGiftEnabled}, updated_at = #{now}, updated_by = #{staffId} WHERE id = 1
mapper.sql: c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM push_subscriptions p WHERE p.customer_id = c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reminder_log w WHERE w.customer_id = c.id AND w.sent_at > #{weekAgo})
LEFT JOIN loyalty_accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN reward_rules r ON r.id = coalesce(a.reward_rule_id, (SELECT id FROM reward_rules WHERE active))
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, AS cycle_key, a.current_stamps AS current, r.stamps_required AS required FROM customers c
WHERE AND r.stamps_required > 1 AND a.current_stamps = r.stamps_required - 1 AND <= #{visitedBefore} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reminder_log l WHERE l.customer_id = c.id AND l.kind = 'NEAR_REWARD' AND l.cycle_key = ) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.id) c.id AS customer_id, g.id::text || ':' || AS cycle_key, 0 AS current, 0 AS required FROM customers c JOIN rewards g ON g.customer_id = c.id AND g.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at > #{now}) WHERE AND <= #{visitedBefore} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reminder_log l WHERE l.customer_id = c.id AND l.kind = 'UNUSED_GIFT' AND l.cycle_key = g.id::text || ':' || ) ORDER BY c.id, g.earned_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, AS cycle_key, coalesce(a.current_stamps, 0) AS current, coalesce(r.stamps_required, 0) AS required FROM customers c
WHERE AND <= #{visitedBefore} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reminder_log l WHERE l.customer_id = c.id AND l.kind = 'WINBACK' AND l.cycle_key = ) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reminder_log (id, customer_id, kind, cycle_key, sent_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{kind}, #{cycleKey}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (customer_id, kind, cycle_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT l.kind, count(*) AS sent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stamps s WHERE s.customer_id = l.customer_id AND s.source = 'NFC_TAP' AND s.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND s.created_at > l.sent_at AND s.created_at <= l.sent_at + interval '7 days')) AS returned FROM reminder_log l WHERE l.sent_at >= #{since} GROUP BY l.kind
